title: Protect unsaved editorial navigation and product-only suggestion imports
summary: Guard product switching/closing while edits or saves are pending, and expose scoped suggestion IDs through the editorial read endpoint. Add isolated actual-React browser coverage.

changes.detail: Dirty product switch/close requires explicit discard; busy operations block selection changes. Product editors obtain only current completed suggestion IDs without category/budget permissions.

Optional suggestion failure preserves manual drafting; paginated history skips suggestion queries; browser fixture exercises navigation, save/conflict/rebase, FR/AR import, consent, publication controls and rollback.

validation.name: Local tests and browser
validation.detail: Pending. Browser uses a fresh profile and loopback-only fixtures, no real sessions or hosted APIs.

validation.name: Staging read-only
validation.detail: Fresh MCP: PostgreSQL 17.11, read-only role/session, empty public tables, migrations, functions and Storage buckets; no foreign servers/subscriptions/cron/network queues. Platform/external isolation still unverified.
